messages:
jen-support: Hey team — VelaCraft can't find their API key in the console after SSO onboarding. They say console shows a key notification but SDKs get 403. Ticket #VC-412 attached: https://support.redwood.ai/t/VC-412

jen-support: Quick context: they used OIDC SSO via Okta, completed consent, saw 'API key created' toast, but their app receives 403 when calling embeddings endpoint. Customer says key id shows in UI but not returned by /v1/projects/:id/keys API.

mary-devex: Thanks — can you paste the exact 403 body and the curl they used? small chance it's an audience/scope mismatch.

jen-support: Sent sample curl from their dev:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-customer-visible-in-console" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-small","input":"hello"}'
```
Response: 403 Forbidden 
```
{"error":"forbidden","message":"API key not scoped to project"}
```

sam-platform: That message suggests the token was created but scoped to a different project/org. Can you share the project ID the customer expects and a screenshot of the key metadata from the console (if possible)?

jen-support: Project they expect: velacraft-prod (proj_9Zr7). Screenshot shows key id abc_9X visible in UI with label "VelaCraft starter" but project column says "unassigned". Customer screenshot attached.

eli-provisioner-bot: provisioner: claim processed for OIDC user 'vela-okta|u123'. created key abc_9X scoping=internal-service-project (proj_internal_3). provisioning-job=jl-778.

sam-platform: Aha — provisioner bound the claim to an internal project instead of the customer's project. That's why the key appears in console but 403 when used against velacraft-prod. Likely org-mapper returned wrong tenancy attribute during claim processing.

alex-eng: I'm on it. Can you share the provisioner job id and any audit id from the UI? I'll check the mapper rules.

jen-support: job id jl-778 (from bot), audit id visible in UI: audit_2026_05_12_77

alex-eng: quick triage — found rule in org-mapper where external_id matching regex for partner accounts was overly broad. It matched 'vela' substring and defaulted to internal project. Reproduced in staging.

alex-eng: Fix: tighten regex + add explicit priority for OIDC tenant claim mapping. I'll patch and re-run repro for jl-778. ETA ~30m.

mary-devex: For support steps: if needed we can manually rebind key to proj_9Zr7 in the console as a short-term mitigation. Procedure: Admin -> Keys -> select key -> Actions -> Reassign to project. But note this bypasses audit trail of re-issuance. Use only with customer consent.

jen-support: Customer asked for ETA. I told them we'll update in ~30-45m and offered manual rebind if they need immediate access.

alex-eng: Deployed mapper patch to staging then prod. Re-ran provisioning job jl-778 in replay mode — key now created scoped to proj_9Zr7. I performed manual rebind for abc_9X to proj_9Zr7 as emergency fallback.

eli-provisioner-bot: provisioner: replayed job jl-778 -> created key abc_9X scoped_to=proj_9Zr7; previous key abc_9X (proj_internal_3) revoked; audit=audit_2026_05_12_77-updated

jen-support: Redeployed fix and did manual rebind. Customer confirmed their dev gets 200 now. They ran the same curl and got embeddings back.

vela-customer (via DM): "works now, thanks. Please tell us what happened so we can update our onboarding notes."

jen-support: Will send postmortem summary. Closing ticket after PM review. :tada:

mary-devex: Note for docs: add a troubleshooting checklist: 1) confirm key project column in UI 2) if 403, check provisioner job id in audit 3) if internal binding, escalate to eng-provisioner. I'll add a short KB entry.

sam-platform: Also adding a monitoring alert for unusual counts of keys created with 'unassigned' project label in last 24h.

jen-support: Thanks all — marking resolved.
